{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.00

|gr1= Map and Markers

|descr= Checks if map zoom level is in between given interval.

|s1= [<nowiki/>[min, max]] call [[BIS_fnc_isInZoom]]

|p1= min: [[Number]] - start of interval

|p2= max: [[Number]] - end of interval

|r1= [[Boolean]]

|x1= <sqf>
if ([[0.001, 0.02]] call BIS_fnc_isInZoom) then 
{
  hint "Zoom level is in between 0.001 and 0.02";
};
</sqf>

|seealso= [[ctrlMapScale]]
}}
